instruction: Locate the NFL stats leaders page for the 2021 season.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the 2021 stats leaders page on NFL.com. Uses regex pattern to match various stats leader URLs for 2021 season. Similar difficulty to original task, requiring site navigation through menu system.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active URL from accessibility tree using standard result type 'active_url_from_accessTree'
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly performs regex pattern matching on the URL
Regex pattern 'https://www\.nfl\.com/stats/.*2021' accurately captures both requirements: NFL stats section (/stats/) AND 2021 season
Expected value structure is correct for type='rule' configuration - metric receives rules dict directly and accesses patterns via rules['expected']
Complete coverage of all instruction requirements: NFL stats leaders page verified by /stats/ path, 2021 season verified by '2021' in pattern
No edge cases or runtime issues - handles None/empty URLs, properly escaped regex, works with various stats pages (passing, rushing, etc.)
No postconfig needed - URL state is directly accessible from accessibility tree
